item.title: Postgres.app 2.9.7
item.description:
• PostgreSQL 14.25 with PostGIS 3.2.10
  • PostgreSQL 15.20 with PostGIS 3.3.10
  • PostgreSQL 16.16 with PostGIS 3.4.6
  • PostgreSQL 17.12 with PostGIS 3.5.6
  • PostgreSQL 18.7 with PostGIS 3.6.3

PostgreSQL 14 has reached the end of its support period. If you are still using a PostgreSQL 14 database, update to a newer version as soon as possible.

You can find more info on the Github Releases Page.

item.title: Postgres.app 3.0
item.description:
PostgreSQL 19 is now available!

  • PostgreSQL 14.25 with PostGIS 3.2.10
  • PostgreSQL 15.20 with PostGIS 3.3.10
  • PostgreSQL 16.16 with PostGIS 3.4.6
  • PostgreSQL 17.12 with PostGIS 3.5.6
  • PostgreSQL 18.7 with PostGIS 3.6.3
  • PostgreSQL 19.0 with PostGIS 3.7.0

PostgreSQL 14 has reached the end of its support period. The next version of Postgres.app will no longer include PostgreSQL 14. If you are still using a PostgreSQL 14 database, update to a newer version as soon as possible.

You can find more info on the Github Releases Page.
